faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about WOLV staking and the WolvCapital protocol.
faq.q1: How does WolvCapital calculate staking rewards?
faq.a1: WolvCapital locks your principal in smart contracts deployed on BNB Smart Chain. Rewards accumulate based on your chosen staking tier and lock period, then distributed as WOLV tokens on-chain. All reward activity is publicly verifiable on BSCScan at any time using your wallet address. Staking rewards are not guaranteed and are subject to market conditions.
faq.a2: WolvCapital operates under FinCEN Money Services Business (MSB) registration for AML/KYC compliance purposes. We enforce full KYC verification on all accounts. WOLV is a BEP20 utility token on BNB Smart Chain — not a security. For compliance enquiries contact legal@wolvcapital.com.
faq.a3: No. WolvCapital does not guarantee any staking reward. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile. Your principal value can fall significantly and you may lose some or all of your staked capital. Past performance does not guarantee future results. APY figures are target estimates only — not promises of return.
faq.q4: How and when can I claim or unstake my WOLV rewards?
faq.a4: WOLV staking rewards accumulate on-chain and are claimable after your lock period ends. Lock periods vary by tier: Pioneer (90 days), Vanguard (150 days), Horizon (180 days), and Summit VIP (365 days). After your lock-up period, you may unstake and your principal is returned within 5 business days via on-chain transaction. Early unstaking incurs a penalty fee. Earned WOLV can be traded on PancakeSwap V2 at any time.
faq.q5: What are lock periods and early exit fees?
faq.a5: Each staking tier has a minimum lock period. Pioneer: 90 days, Vanguard: 150 days, Horizon: 180 days, Summit VIP: 365 days. Funds are locked during this period. Early exit fees apply to principal: Pioneer 2%, Vanguard 2.5%, Horizon 3%, Summit VIP 3.5%. At term end, your position rolls monthly (Pioneer, Vanguard, Horizon) or quarterly (Summit VIP) unless you withdraw. You will receive notification 7–14 days before your term expires.
faq.a6: Staked assets are held in smart contracts deployed on BNB Smart Chain, with custody through Coinbase Custody for institutional-grade asset protection. Your funds are segregated from WolvCapital operational accounts. Contract addresses are publicly verifiable on BSCScan.
faq.a7: WolvCapital charges a platform fee ranging from 1–2% annually based on your staking tier (Pioneer 1%, Vanguard 1.25%, Horizon 1.5%, Summit VIP 2%), charged monthly. There are no hidden fees. The full fee schedule is available in your dashboard before activating any staking position.
faq.a8: WolvCapital supports users from 120+ countries, subject to local regulations. Residents of OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions are not eligible. All users must complete KYC verification before staking. Check the eligibility page or contact support for your specific country before signing up.
faq.a9: WolvCapital generates quarterly on-chain staking reports downloadable from your dashboard, detailing your WOLV rewards received and transaction history. You are responsible for filing and paying taxes on your digital asset activity under your local tax laws. Digital asset tax treatment varies significantly by country — consult a qualified tax professional for advice specific to your situation.
faq.q10: What happens to my funds if WolvCapital is unavailable?
faq.a10: Staked assets are held in smart contracts on BNB Smart Chain and through Coinbase Custody, fully segregated from WolvCapital operational accounts. Smart contract logic governs fund release independently. In the event of any platform disruption, your withdrawal rights are preserved through the on-chain contract. Contract addresses are publicly verifiable on BSCScan.
faq.a11: Yes — WOLV is now live and trading on PancakeSwap V2 (BNB Smart Chain). The WOLV/BNB pair is active and can be traded by anyone with a BNB wallet. Contract: 0xe0167279aef7bf4ad313d261da82e8366822270c — verified on BSCScan. Track live price and chart on DEXScreener and DEXTools.
